description: Given a list of recent period start dates (from any source), returns the current phase, cycle day, estimated cycle length, next-period date, and confidence. v0.3.2 adds a `late_luteal` sub-phase (triggered when the cycle is past its expected end + grace day) plus `days_past_due` and `delay_flag` (raised when ≥2 days late vs prediction from 3+ historical cycles). v0.3.3 adds `cycle_irregular` (PCOS / irregular-cycle mode): when true, accepts cycles 21-90 days, caps confidence at 'low', returns `luteal_extended` + `irregular_window: true` past 35 days since last period, and adds a clinician-defer warning.

cycle_irregular.description: v0.3.3 — PCOS / irregular-cycle mode. When true: accepts cycles 21-90 days, caps confidence at 'low', returns `luteal_extended` when days_since_last > 35, and adds a clinician-defer warning string. Default false.

history.description: Array of {start_date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', length_days?: number}. Sorted automatically.

privacy_mode.description: Optional privacy mode: summary | structured | raw. summary omits free-text notes when present; structured/raw return full payload.

today.description: Optional reference date; defaults to system today.
